summary: Iteration 3 backend tests — 17/17 passed in 21s. Validated boss-fight endpoints (PATCH /api/tasks/{id}/boss singleton behaviour, GET /api/tasks/boss returning current/null, 404 on unknown id), 2x XP multiplier on toggle for boss tasks (xp_awarded == task.xp*2 on complete and -2x on un-toggle, 1x for non-boss confirmed), AI POST /api/ai/linkedin-recap (empty-week message + with-entries Claude post returning 'post' string), AI POST /api/ai/skin-analysis (ready:false with <3 logs, ready:true with seeded 3 logs and Claude paragraph), and tasks CRUD regression. PWA static assets (/manifest.json, /service-worker.js, /icon-192.png) all return 200 via Kubernetes ingress and contain valid content.

minor.issue: Task pydantic model omits is_boss field, so the flag is not surfaced in /api/tasks list responses — UI must call GET /api/tasks/boss separately to know which task is the boss. Consider adding is_boss: bool = False to the Task model so the FE can render a boss badge inline without an extra request.
No DELETE endpoint for skin issue logs; iter3 seed data (3 entries marked TEST_skin_seed_*) cannot be cleaned via the API and remains in the skin issue_log collection.

action_items: (Optional) Add is_boss field to Task pydantic model so /api/tasks list surfaces the flag without a second request.
(Optional) Add DELETE /api/skin issue-log/{id} so test seed data and user mistakes can be removed.
critical_code_review_comments: toggle_boss correctly clears all other boss flags via update_many before setting the new one — singleton invariant holds.
GET /api/tasks/boss filters by is_boss:True AND completed:False — completing the boss task makes /tasks/boss return null automatically (good UX).

linkedin-recap fallback path returns 200 with fallback:True even when EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is missing — graceful degradation is good. Consider also checking that 'entries_used' or 'fallback' is always present so the FE can branch consistently.

skin-analysis fallback divides by max(1, count) to avoid div-by-zero — defensive, but if every entry has no_sugar=True the 'avg_with_sugar' falls back to 0.0 which could be misleading. Edge case low impact.
Both AI endpoints use POST with no body; declaring an empty Pydantic body or switching to GET would be more idiomatic, but functionally fine.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_-prefixed tasks (bossA/B/C, normal1x, boss2x, regression task, to_delete) — all deleted in fixture teardown. One TEST_ career entry seeded and deleted within the linkedin-recap test. Three TEST_skin_seed_* skin issue logs were seeded (today's date) and remain because there is no DELETE endpoint for /api/skin issue-log.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 1 (test_backend_api.py), Iter 2 (test_achievements_public.py), Iter 3 (test_iter3_boss_ai_pwa.py) all pass. The /api/tasks Task response model does not include is_boss — relying on /api/tasks/boss is the current contract. Skin IssueLog has 3 lingering TEST_skin_seed_* entries that may slightly inflate skin issue_count for the 'alchemist' achievement (target 10).
